summary: Frontend-only verification of secure Owner View-As (role impersonation) wiring. All 5 feature points verified on desktop 1920x800 and mobile 390x844. Owner login, switch-to-Sales entering View-As, exit-view-as-btn restoring Owner session without re-auth, mobile tab-exit-view-as-btn, and owner nav regression all pass.
verified_flows: Owner login as HaulYeahAdmin lands on Owner view; role-switch-select visible in sidebar footer.

Click role-switch-select → switch-option-sales enters Sales View-As: exit-view-as-btn appears with text 'Viewing as Sales — exit'; role-switch-select removed; owner-only nav (Dashboard, Fleet, Dispatch, Settings) hidden; Sales nav (Leads, Scope Calculator, Script) shown.
localStorage shows hy_owner_token preserved and distinct from hy_token during View-As (view_as=1, role=sales).
Click exit-view-as-btn restores Owner view instantly (no network switch-role call to owner — frontend swaps token and calls /auth/me); role-switch-select reappears and Owner Dashboard nav back.

Mobile 390x844: in Owner view the More sheet shows tab-account-select (not exit button). Selecting Sales view enters View-As; reopening More sheet shows tab-exit-view-as-btn (and tab-account-select is gone). Clicking tab-exit-view-as-btn restores Owner view; state becomes role=owner, view_as=0, can_switch=1; tab-account-select returns.
Regression: desktop sidebar nav (Jobs, Team, Settings, Dashboard) still clickable and functional in Owner view.
critical_code_review_comments: Minor accessibility warning from Radix: 'Missing Description or aria-describedby for DialogContent' in CommandDialog (JumpTo) and SheetContent — add aria-describedby or DialogDescription to silence.

AuthGate restores owner session purely from hy_owner_token in localStorage; if a user clears storage they lose the ability to exit View-As without re-login. Acceptable per security spec, but worth a user-visible fallback (e.g., force logout) if token is missing — currently switchRole('owner') falls through to switchRoleApi which will 403 for a View-As token.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Phase 1 Problem #7 (View-As security) frontend wiring is verified. Backend already pytest-passed 43/43. If retesting, note that a 401 on an owner-only endpoint (e.g., /api/dashboard) while in Sales View-As view is expected and does NOT log the user out because the axios interceptor only clears hy_token on 401, and useEffect in AuthGate falls back to hy_owner_token if /auth/me fails. During mobile tests, viewport switching after a role switch can appear flaky in a single playwright run; re-logging in and running the mobile flow isolated works deterministically.
